description: ABSTRACT-CLAIM EXPANSION: a we/this study/the present study subject, up to three intervening words, and replicate/replicated/replicates, followed within the same clause and at most 120 characters by an author-year-style reference. Two arms, either of which admits. (1) The MEASURED arm, unchanged from the sampling: a word, optional et al., optional parentheses and a 19xx/20xx year. The engine prefixes every pattern with (?i), so its [A-Z] matches any word and it also admits word-plus-number noise ('with 2000 participants'); it is kept because it also catches real claims whose year comes before or far from the name ('the 1978 Dermer and Pysczinski study'). (2) The CITATION arm: a surname in a scoped (?-i:...) group that restores case sensitivity (a capital, ASCII or Latin-1), optionally followed by et al., 'and colleagues' or a study noun ('Swanson's study (1986)'), then an optional comma, so APA's '(Smith et al., 2009)' and 'Smith, 2019' match; RE2 and Python re both honour the scoped flag. The union loses nothing the measured pattern admitted. Citation proximity does not establish the target, intent or completion: this is an admission to the two-voter screen, and the measured pool includes methods reuse and planned studies. Precedence 737: below replication-claim-extend-prior (738), title-broad (740), curated-observatory (745) and stronger title rules; above replication-claim-failure-prior (736) and general (735). This order follows the marginal measurement, extension first then cited claims. It yields to structural discards (935-960) and outranks the fallible type crosswalk (500). Repository DOI and replication-package/materials/data/code title exclusions are copied verbatim from the live general rule. The rule requires an abstract, names no vocabulary and only schedules screening. Measured over the f4225e6 live-bundle baseline; analysis/admission_rules_2026_10/README.md records the frozen population, marginal order, uncertainty and model labels.

measured.sample: analysis/admission_rules_2026_10/screened_cases.csv, rule=replication-claim-cited-abstract; 251 previously reviewed marginal works plus 60 uniformly sampled fresh works (seed 20261007) from the remaining marginal pool, read blind from title and abstract; see populations.csv and manifest.json.
measured.rationale: 1585 additional available works after preceding new rules, excluding existing live screening admissions, FLoRA doi_r, exported and validated-skip works. Fresh pilot: 35/60 clear with source-matched quotes and no obvious title/abstract mismatch. Previously reviewed members: 169/251 clear under the same policy. Precision field is a population-weighted estimate of model-judged actionable yield (0.598), not independently validated truth or the production two-voter proceed rate. Conditional fresh-sample Wilson interval, weighted with the observed previous members: 0.491-0.695; no bound on model-label error. Admission only; no automatic acceptance/discard and no screen-generation change.
